# PropertyPicker

Pointr Cloud's "+ Add additional field" (CLOUD-UI-003): a subtle Button the width of its form that opens a search over the properties a product can add, each with its type, under Suggested and Others tabs while anything is suggested, and a Custom field action after the list. A Dashboard module: it ships from `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard`, with `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard.css` loaded after the package's `style.css`, and only on the web.

- **Import:** `import { PropertyPicker } from "@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard";`
- **Stylesheet:** `import "@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard.css";`, after the package's `style.css`: a Dashboard module's rules are in this sheet alone.
- **Group:** Dashboard
- **Platforms:** React; not linked to Figma yet.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/dashboard-propertypicker--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";
import {
  PropertyPicker,
  type PropertyPickerProperty,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard";

const SAMPLE: Array<[string, string, string?]> = [
  ["Access Programs", "Array", "Named access program accepted"],
  ["Access Restrictions", "Enum", "Who may enter, and on what terms"],
  ["Accessibility Notes", "Text"],
  ["Address", "Text"],
  ["Alternative Names", "Array", "Other names visitors search for"],
  ["Amenities", "Array"],
  ["Booking Url", "Hyperlink", "Where a visitor books it"],
  ["Brand", "Text"],
  ["Capacity", "Integer", "How many people it holds"],
  ["Category", "Enum"],
  ["Contact Email", "Email"],
  ["Cover Image", "Image"],
  ["Currency", "Enum"],
  ["Description", "Text", "A sentence or two shown on the place's card"],
  ["Dress Code", "Text"],
  ["External Id", "Text", "The place's id in another system"],
  ["Facebook Url", "Hyperlink"],
  ["Floor Area", "Integer"],
  ["Gate Number", "Text"],
  ["Has Assistance", "Boolean", "Staff can help visitors here"],
  ["Has Baby Changing", "Boolean"],
  ["Has Charging Points", "Boolean"],
  ["Has Parking", "Boolean"],
  ["Has Wifi", "Boolean", "Visitors can connect to Wi-Fi here"],
  ["Images", "Image"],
  ["Instagram Url", "Hyperlink"],
  ["Is Accessible Toilet", "Boolean"],
  ["Is Gender Neutral", "Boolean"],
  ["Is Pet Friendly", "Boolean"],
  ["Is Smoking Area", "Boolean"],
  ["Is Wheelchair Accessible", "Boolean"],
  ["Keywords", "Array"],
  ["Languages Spoken", "Array"],
  ["Logo", "Image"],
  ["Max Occupancy", "Integer"],
  ["Menu Url", "Hyperlink"],
  ["Occupancy Status", "Enum", "Whether it is free, busy or full now"],
  ["Opening Hours", "Object", "When it is open, day by day"],
  ["Order Url", "Hyperlink"],
  ["Payment Methods", "Array"],
  ["Phone Number", "Hyperlink"],
  ["Price Range", "Enum"],
  ["Rating", "Object"],
  ["Reservation Email", "Email"],
  ["Room Number", "Text"],
  ["Seating", "Integer"],
  ["Security Level", "Enum"],
  ["Short Name", "Text"],
  ["Social Links", "Object"],
  ["Support Email", "Email"],
  ["Tags", "Array"],
  ["Terminal", "Text"],
  ["Ticket Required", "Boolean"],
  ["Twitter Url", "Hyperlink"],
  ["Vendor Code", "Text"],
  ["Video Tour", "Hyperlink"],
  ["Website Url", "Hyperlink"],
  ["Zone", "Enum"],
];

const BOOTH = new Set([
  "Access Restrictions",
  "Description",
  "Has Assistance",
  "Has Wifi",
  "Occupancy Status",
]);

function sample(suggest: boolean): PropertyPickerProperty[] {
  return SAMPLE.map(([name, type, description]) => ({
    id: name.toLowerCase().replace(/ /g, "-"),
    name,
    type,
    description,
    suggested: suggest && BOOTH.has(name) ? true : undefined,
  }));
}

export function PropertyPickerExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <PropertyPicker
        properties={sample(false)}
        onSelect={() => {}}
        onCustomField={() => {}}
      />
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## PropertyPicker

Pointr Cloud's "+ Add additional field" (CLOUD-UI-003): a subtle Button
the width of its form that opens a search over the properties a product
can add, under Suggested and Others tabs while anything is suggested, and
a "Custom field" action after the list.

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `PropertyPickerProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "onSelect" | "children">`.

- `properties`: `PropertyPickerProperty[]`, **required**.

  The properties that can still be added: leave out those already on the form.

- `onSelect`: `(property: PropertyPickerProperty) => void`, **required**.

  Called with the property chosen. The picker closes, and the focus goes back to its button.

- `onCustomField`: `() => void`, optional.

  Called by the "Custom field" action, drawn after the list, always, while
  this is given. The picker closes as it does on a choice.

- `open`: `boolean`, optional.

  Open, controlled. Pair with `onOpenChange`.

- `defaultOpen`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.

  Open as it first draws, uncontrolled.

- `onOpenChange`: `(open: boolean) => void`, optional.
- `disabled`: `boolean`, optional.
- `label`: `string`, optional, default `"Add additional field"`.

  The button's words, and the popup's name. Default "Add additional field".

- `searchLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Search properties"`.

  The search field's label. Default "Search properties".

- `searchPlaceholder`: `string`, optional, default `"Search"`.

  Default "Search".

- `clearSearchLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Clear search"`.

  The search's clear button's name. Default "Clear search".

- `suggestedLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Suggested"`.

  The suggested properties' tab and group. Default "Suggested".

- `othersLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Others"`.

  Every other property's tab and group. Default "Others".

- `listLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Properties"`.

  The list's name while it is not a tab's. Default "Properties".

- `emptyTitle`: `string`, optional, default `"No properties match"`.

  Said and shown when the search finds nothing. Default "No properties match".

- `emptyDescription`: `string`, optional.

  Under the empty title. Default none.

- `customFieldLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Custom field"`.

  The custom field action's words. Default "Custom field".

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### PropertyPickerProperty

From `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard`.

```ts
/**
 * A property a product can add to a form: data, already in the page's
 * language. `type` is what the property holds, as the product names it
 * ("Text", "Boolean", "Hyperlink"), and is drawn beside its name.
 */
interface PropertyPickerProperty {
  /** Stable and unique among the properties; what `onSelect` hands back. */
  id: string;
  /** What the search finds it by, and what the row says. */
  name: string;
  /** What it holds, in the page's language ("Text", "Enum", "Image"). */
  type: string;
  /** What it means, in a sentence: drawn after its type, and read with it. */
  description?: string;
  /**
   * Suggested for what is being edited (a Booth's five). Suggested
   * properties are listed first, under the Suggested tab, and never again
   * under Others.
   */
  suggested?: boolean;
}
```
